page.title: Meetings
page.description: Review booked meetings' status, external sync, and attendance outcomes; reschedule or cancel.

list.caption: Booked meetings
list.emptyDescription: Adjust the range, status, or host filters — or issue a booking link to receive new bookings.

statusNote.held: The slot is tentatively held. It is not shown as confirmed until confirmation completes.
statusNote.confirming: Confirming the event on the external calendar. Not a confirmed booking yet.
statusNote.canceling: Cancellation requested. It becomes canceled once the external calendar confirms.
statusNote.unknown: The external calendar outcome could not be verified. The slot stays held and needs operator investigation.
statusNote.failed: Creating the external calendar event failed; the hold was released.
statusNote.canceled: Cancellation was confirmed on the external calendar.
statusNote.confirmed: Booking confirmed on the external calendar.

detail.title: Booking details
detail.investigateBody: We could not verify whether the event was created on the external calendar. The slot stays held. Do not re-request — check the calendar connection and operations jobs.

reschedule.title: Reschedule
reschedule.description: Pick a new start time. The old slot stays until the change is confirmed on the external calendar.
reschedule.success: Change requested. It is confirmed after the external calendar verifies it.
reschedule.conflict: Another change was applied first. Reload the latest state and try again.

cancel.title: Cancel booking
cancel.description: The cancellation completes only after the external calendar confirms it.
cancel.reasonPlaceholder: A note for the guest or the team
cancel.note: Cancellation is shown as done only after external confirmation.

attendance.title: Record attendance
attendance.description: Record what actually happened. The booking status and the attendance outcome are separate.

link.title: Issue booking link
link.description: Create a public link where a guest picks a time themselves.
link.noTypes: No active meeting types. Create a meeting type first.
link.createdBody: This link is shown only now. Share it over a safe channel.
link.urlMissing: The response had no URL — ask an administrator.

types.pageDescription: Manage meeting types used for public booking and per-host availability.
types.caption: Meeting type list
types.emptyDescription: Create a meeting type to issue booking links.
types.fieldHostFixed: The host cannot change. Create a new type for another host.
types.calendarNone: No active calendar connection. Connect a calendar in Settings first.
types.conflictBody: Someone else saved first. Pick which value to keep for each field.

availability.title: Host availability
availability.description: Manage weekly rules and exceptions for when booking is possible. Rule times are local to the selected time zone.
availability.rulesNote: Split windows crossing midnight into two rules.
availability.exceptionsNote: Vacations or one-off availability for a specific period. Blocked wins over available.
availability.exceptionInTz: Enter exception times in the time zone above.
availability.conflict: Someone else saved first. Reload the latest values and try again.
availability.invalidRule: Each rule's end must be after its start.
availability.invalidException: Each exception's end must be after its start.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.conflict: Another change was applied first. Reload the latest state and try again.
errors.precondition: Missing version information. Refresh and try again.
errors.slotUnavailable: That slot is no longer available.
errors.calendarUnavailable: Could not verify the calendar connection. Try again shortly.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
errors.generic: Could not process the request. Try again.
